more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Magnesium silicate is used as an anti-caking agent in food. Its technological role is to help powders stay free-flowing.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA could not assess food-use safety because the toxicology data were insufficient in 2018.
The former shared silicate intake limit was considered obsolete.
